declaration.reference_index: lpbf_public_datasets.normalized_enthalpy at A 0.38, solid props, 20 C; computed once, never at A_D

absorptance_map.source: Deisenroth 2020 Fig. 7, bare IN625, 65 um D4sigma, 500 mm/s (SOURCES 2.1)
absorptance_map.interpolation: piecewise linear in reference index, flat outside

conduction_leg.call: calculate_meltpool_physics('Inconel 625', P, v, D4sigma, preheat_temp_C=20.0, heat_source='rosenthal', prop_overrides={'absorptivity_IR': A_D})

keyhole_leg.call: fabbro_keyhole_depth_m(P, v, D4sigma, k_s, alpha_s, T_boil, 20.0, A_D, 99.0)

declaration.link: max(d_c, e_fabbro) above the gate; d_c below

pass_rule.completeness: all held-out rows predicted by H, served_reference, baseline with valid status, else INCONCLUSIVE
pass_rule.lane_verdict: equals H verdict; sensitivities never produce a PASS

declaration.stage2_entry: stage 1 PASS (fragile or not); stage 2 items in section 8; no bump from stage 1

nist_ingestion.deduplication: mean W and D within exact folder/image; retain source row numbers
nist_ingestion.cluster_rule: date/plate folder with terminal _Set1/_Set2 removed + track + direction

bootstrap_pooled_gain_H_over_served_refe.note: descriptive only; clusters are inferred, not independent campaigns
